sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated — personal mirror manifest
sources.snippet: The author describes this model as an uncensored version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B created with abliteration. The model card says that this is a crude proof-of-concept implementation for reducing refusals from an LLM without using TransformerLens.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated — Abliterated Model Card
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is a refusal-ablated build of Qwen3.8-27B, released by huihui-ai, 27B parameters, available in GGUF, Transformers and NVFP4.
